CONTENT.MASTERIDENTIFIER: 16-004/26 - UPDATED SOFTWARE RELEASE FOR COCKPIT DOMAIN CONTROLLER (CDC) AND DATA COMMUNICATION MODULE (DCM)

SERVICE_INFORMATION.TITLE: 16-004/26 - UPDATED SOFTWARE RELEASE FOR COCKPIT DOMAIN CONTROLLER (CDC) AND DATA COMMUNICATION MODULE (DCM)
SERVICE_INFORMATION.BULLETIN_NOTES:
This TSB has been superceded by SSPE2 AND MSP67.
Previous TSBs: Date(s) Issued:
16-004/26 06/24/26, 05/19/26 and 05/06/2026

APPLICABLE MODEL(S)/VINS
2026 CX-5
SERVICE_INFORMATION.DESCRIPTION:
The release notes outlined below provide an overview of bug fixes, feature improvements, and updates included in the latest DCM and CDC software updates. The latest version of software contains all the updates of the previous versions.

For DCM:
Version KLAS-67CK3-L fixes these software errors (bugs):
  • The system is in OTA reprogramming available mode
Version KLAS-67CK3-K fixes these software errors (bugs):
  • Google-related functions (e.g., voice recognition), smartphone-based remote-control operations, and connected services may not function.
  • Remote-control operations (e.g., door lock and hazard light activation) and vehicle status monitoring via the MyMazda App may not be available.
Version KLAS-67CK3-J fixes these software errors (bugs):
  • A beep sound is emitted from near the SOS switch (further improvement).
  • Google-related functions, such as voice recognition, smartphone remote operations, and connected service subscriptions are not available.
  • The volume of the beep sound when a DCM malfunction is detected has been reduced.
Version KLAS-67CK3-K fixes these software errors (bugs):
  • Google-related functions (e.g., voice recognition), smartphone-based remote-control operations, and connected services may not function.
  • Remote-control operations (e.g., door lock and hazard light activation) and vehicle status monitoring via the MyMazda App may not be available.
Version KLAS-67CK3-H fixes these software errors (bugs):
  • 12 V Battery discharged.
Version KLAS-67CK3-G fixes these software errors (bugs):
  • The pictograph antenna icon on the upper part of the center display shows a globe with a slash mark.
  • DCM internal battery malfunction (DTC B1477:00, B1477:16 are stored).
  • The SOS button illuminates red.
  • Remote operation may fail.
  • A beep sound may be emitted from the DCM.
  • Improvements for communication stability.

For CDC:
Versions KLAS-66CD1-D (VIP), KLEJ-66CD2-F (PVM) and KL**-66CD3-G (GVM) fixes these software errors (bugs):

  • Communication in the Cockpit Domain Controller (CDC) and Data Communication Module (DCM), may be interrupted, making the connected services unavailable. The interruption may cause the master warning light to illuminatea and audible warning from the emergency call speaker.
  • Due to an improper communication control program in the CDC and DCM, may prevent OTA software updates to be completed. In addition, if an OTA software update is successfully completed, the vehicle's software configuration status may not be correctly transmitted to the server, which may prevent notification of subsequent software updates. Successfully completed OTA software updates may not properly sync with Mazda’s servers potentially preventing future OTA updates.
Versions KLAS-66CD1-D (VIP), KLEJ-66CD2-E (PVM) and KL**-66CD3-F (GVM) fixes these software errors (bugs):
  • SOS button illuminates red and emits a beep sound immediately after IG ON (DTC U2701:89 is stored), with an additional update.
  • Text updated in the “Data Communication Information” screen under Settings > Privacy > Data Communication.
Versions KLAS-66CD1-D (VIP), KLEJ-66CD2-D (PVM) and KL**-66CD3-E (GVM) fixes these software errors (bugs):
  • SOS button illuminates red and emits a beep sound immediately after IG ON (DTC U2701:89 is stored).
  • The pictograph antenna icon on the upper part of the center display shows a globe symbol.
  • Mazda Connect takes approximately 10 seconds to boot up after engine start, causing a noticeable delay on the display.
  • The display remains black on startup (Reverse camera displays normally when Reverse gear is engaged).
  • Minor improvements for enhanced operational stability and product quality.
  • Apple CarPlay® fails to auto-connect.
